Is There More to Life than This?
For many years I had three objections to the Christian faith. First, I 
thought it was boring. I went to chapel at school and found it very dull. 
I had sympathy with the novelist Robert Louis Stevenson who once 
entered in his diary, as if recording an extraordinary phenomenon, 
‘I have been to church today, and am not depressed.’ My impression 
of the Christian faith was that it was dreary and uninspiring.
